title: Claude now runs my entire social media
description:
Buffer's real product was the dashboard.

That's the part you're deleting.

Scheduling was never the hard part.

Opening the thing was.

Log in, pick a platform, reformat.

Every tab its own small chore.

Postiz ships an agent CLI.

Every command returns clean JSON.

Built for a model to read.

So the dashboard becomes a function call.

You say schedule my week.

It writes, designs, and queues.

Twenty plus platforms, each caption reformatted.

You never open a tab.

Free means no invoice, by the way.

You still run the server.

Like a thermostat instead of a fireplace.

You set it once and leave.

The tool was never the real cost.

The tab switching was.

Tell Claude and walk away.

#postiz #buffer #claude #socialmedia #contentcalendar
